name: Write reflective essays on specific experiences
description: Users asked the AI to write reflective essays, thought reports, or study notes on specific topics such as political speeches, historical events, university courses, and professional training experiences. Many requests specified particular word counts, required the adoption of specific personas (e.g., party members or students), or asked for insights to be derived from provided source materials and personal experiences.
